args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production (unhealthy, error rate 18%) in us-east, us-west and eu-west. Rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the newest release that was healthy in production. Rollback status: rolled_out (us-east, us-west, eu-west now on v2.3.0). Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging before v2.3.1 went to production. Next steps: confirm health has recovered and find the root cause in v2.3.1.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Cause:** v2.3.1 was unhealthy in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions are now on it.
- **Result:** After the rollback the service reports healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the next steps. It also notes that the release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, was already unhealthy in staging before v2.3.1 went to production.

No approval was needed because v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production. The cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs to be found before it's deployed again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
